about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in a world where hope struggles against the abyss of catastrophe and discover a story that could change your destiny.

Explore the post-soviet space that has turned into a single, dark place where anomalies violate the laws of physics and reality.

The protagonist, Voyla - a stalker with a difficult fate - tries to solve the mystery of his wife's disappearance during the cataclysm.

Collect clues, explore the dark corners of the new lands, and unravel the secrets lost among the ruins. Here, in the heart of an abandoned world, you may find not only the answer to Voyla's wife's fate, but also a way to save others from the spawn of the Cataclysm.

«Burned One» — more than just a game, it is an exploration of the breadth and depth of the human soul on the brink of survival. In this world of danger and hope, you will learn to appreciate every moment and not lose faith in the possibility of salvation.

Enter the dark corridors of the post-apocalypse and find out if Voyla will be a guide to the new world or a victim of the old. Your adventure begins now!

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains scenes of murder, blood, references to murder, references to alcohol consumption, and references to tobacco use.
